name: Chat Bubble
description: Conversation message bubbles for AI assistant chat, with user and AI distinct styles, streaming/reasoning/tool-call support. 时间戳显示在一轮对话的开始处，即用户气泡的正上方，水平居中。无角色标签（代码中不存在'你'/'Sumi'标签）

variants.name: Greeting
variants.description: Centered AI greeting message shown in empty state

variants.name: User Message
variants.description: User's question in mint (primary-100) bubble aligned to the right, on-surface text color

variants.name: AI Response
variants.description: AI's reply in paper (white) bubble with line@0.3 border and subtle shadow, aligned to the left

variants.name: Streaming
variants.description: Streaming output state: shows 14x14 CircularProgressIndicator(mintDeep) when empty, 2x16 blinking cursor (mintDeep) at end when content is present

variants.name: Reasoning
variants.description: AI thinking/reasoning process, displayed in a collapsible region

variants.name: Tool Call
variants.description: Tool invocation indicator, rendered as a pill with light primary background

variants.name: Tool Result
variants.description: Tool execution result, displayed in a collapsible region

states.name: long-press-user
states.description: Long press on user bubble → delete dialog (radius-card corner)

states.name: long-press-ai
states.description: Long press on AI bubble → copy + toast '已复制'

uiCopySamples.greeting: 和 Sumi 聊聊学习计划吧
